findings.body: The check runs after the database write, so an invalid order is stored before the 400 is returned. Move the check above the write.
The tests assert the status code only; they would still pass with the write-before-check bug above. Assert that nothing is written for a rejected order.

summary: The validation is in place but runs after the write, so the change does not do what the request asks. The tests do not catch this.
